headline: Six therapies. [[Short on purpose.]]
body: Every therapy is prescribed for one named patient after a licensed clinician's evaluation, and compounded by a licensed U.S. pharmacy.

headline: If a physician wouldn't prescribe it, [[it's not on our menu.]]
body: None of the research peptides sold online has completed FDA's process to be lawfully compounded. An advisory vote is not an approval.

headline: Popular in gyms. [[Barely studied in people.]]

stat.label: published studies on it from 1993 to 2024 was in humans, with fewer than a dozen patients.
